children: The number of people claiming unemployment benefits eased by 1,000 from the previous month to 206,000 on the first week of September 2026, loosely aligned with expectations of 205,000 to hold the trend of low claim counts since dropping to the near 60-year low of 189,000 in the middle of July.
Continuing claims, a gauge of outstanding unemployment in the US, eased by 1,000 to 1,774,000 in the last week of August, below expectations of 1,780,000.

The data extended the period of resilience in the US labor market despite the unexpected contraction in payrolls per the latest BLS data, aligned with the view from some FOMC members that the US is in full employment.
Meanwhile, initial claims filed by federal employees, which have added spotlight on the administration's signal to shrink the of public sector, rose by 51 to 388.

title: US Initial Unemployment Claims Hold Lower Trend
